paragraphs: Rav Menashe, in Ulla's time. Ulla visited his house; Rabbah spoke to Ulla, Eruvin 104a. I do not know why he made him a separate entry: Ulla and Rav Yehudah lived in one generation, so he is the preceding Rav Yehudah's student. Menashe sat before R. Zeira, Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah 2, halakhah 2. He likewise seems to be the preceding Rav Yehudah's student; although there he is called Rav Menashe, such is the Jerusalem Talmud's usage. Its Zeira is R. Zeira, who was Rav Yehudah's student.
